Conteudo_Comentario: The hardware appear to be identical. The price difference is likely to due whether or not an operating system is installed despite what the advertisements might claim. The online advertisements are sometimes innaccurate, misleading, or mixed up for models in the same series..So before purchase, you should double-check with the vendor on whether or not an operating system is pre-installed. You might have to purchase the operating system separately for the cheaper model.
Acer Nitro 5 AN515-57-54LP Shale Black (NH.QEWEU.00U) have Endless OS that is free as I know and  Acer Nitro 5 AN515-57 (NH.QEWEP.00G) have DOS.

I mean a GUI operating system like Windows 10 or 11.  Latest EOS &  DOS should both be free open source command prompt interfaces. They are not very practical to fully use the capabilities of this laptop.Did you ask the vendor why over a 20% price difference for essentially the same hardware? Because that's about what a Windows license costs.
